findings.description: Both brief list pages downloaded from the official ECE faculty directory (the base page and ?section=emeritus). The two bodies are the same page, differing only in the query-string configuration. Parsed sections: Regular Faculty, Research & Visiting Faculty, Courtesy Appointment, Emeritus Faculty. Every person in the brief appears on a list and every list name matches brief.people. 32 distinct people enumerated, no omissions.
Navigation lists a 'Lecturers and Professorial Lecturers' anchor (#Lecturers), but the page has no lecturer section or entries, so nothing is enumerated under it.
No owner determinations dated 2026-11-25 apply to this roster.
